notes.title: Year of the Monkey Update!
notes.content:
The first update of 2016 is finally here (づ｡◕‿‿◕｡)づ

We have added support for the much requested feature Steam Cloud Saving. 
Many bugs got squashed (▰˘◡˘▰) and the engine has been upgraded ≧◡≦!

We hope you enjoy the new year 🙊 with our delicious update! (◕‿-)
